messages:
erin (devex): support ticket: user on WSL2 + Windows OpenSSH agent reports `redwoodctl login` opens browser and says "token saved" but sample app still 401s. they also see SSH_AUTH_SOCK pointing at a Windows path. anyone seen agent/socket affect login?
mike (eng-cli): that's odd. redwoodctl login shouldn't touch SSH_AUTH_SOCK. do they use `--headless` with an auth-provider that proxies via ssh-agent for key exchange?
sora (eng-runtime): some customers use an external helper that exchanges an SSH-signed assertion for a token. if that helper reads SSH_AUTH_SOCK and it points to a windows-side agent socket (non-unix domain), helper can fail silently and redwoodctl might still try to write a token it didn't receive.
erin (devex): they included sanitized logs: "auth: helper fetch failed: dial unix /mnt/c/Users/alice/ssh-agent.sock: connect: connection refused" then "auth: saved token to /mnt/c/.../default.json" with no error.
mike (eng-cli): looks like two bugs: 1) helper failure is noisy but not fatal, 2) write to /mnt/c succeeded for the windows shim but app running inside WSL expects token in /home.
pat (devops): quick repro: set SSH_AUTH_SOCK to a nonexistent path under /mnt/c, run `redwoodctl login` from Start Menu shim, and the helper times out then redwoodctl falls back to browser flow but writes to windows home.
sora (eng-runtime): fix plan: - make helper failures abort login unless `--insecure-fallback` is explicitly set - ensure token write is validated (reopen/read-after-write) - detect foreign mount paths (like /mnt/c) when running under WSL and warn the user with a short actionable message.
mike (eng-cli): i'll add a CLI check to fail loudly when helper returns error and to print the canonical path where token is written with exists: yes/no. also add `--force-write-home=/home/<user>` for support.
erin (devex): support reply I'll send: unset SSH_AUTH_SOCK in the Start Menu shortcut or run login from a WSL shell, and use `env HOME="$HOME" redwoodctl login` as a workaround. Also include the ticket link GH#7202 once opened.
support-bot: created issue GH#7202 "login helper silent-fallback + WSL foreign-home write confusion"
erin (devex): thanks team. adding quickstart FAQ blurb about SSH_AGENT and WSL launch contexts.
